dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: I do love the feeling of drinking, but stopping after a little... heh, isn't so bad either.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Mm-hm. I like being drunk. What's the phrase... floating on air? But of course, the most important thing is that it lets me escape my worries for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: No matter how much is on my mind, none of it belongs in my glass.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: And if the worries come back, a good strong drink sends them packing. Then all that's left is that nice, floaty feeling to carry me off to sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Hehe. Nezhdanov should give it a try. A little once in a while never hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Goodbye. May your glass never disappoint you.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: He wants to drink his worries away, but he's afraid he'll make a scene. He wants to have fun for once, but he still has too much on his mind.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: So I suppose he'll just drown his sorrows in Fonta and end up even sadder. Or in milk, maybe. That's his choice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I mean, cutting back on alcohol isn't a bad thing...

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Exactly. Drink less, and you'll be healthier. And once you're healthier, you can drink even more...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...That sounds like something a drunk person would say.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Maybe. But compared to the real drunks I know, I hardly drink at all.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Good wine is wonderful and all, but I do still have work to get done.
